welcome.title: A clearer moment starts here.
welcome.body: FreeCBT helps you slow down, look closer, and find a more balanced thought.

privacy.title: No account. No cloud required.
privacy.body: Your journal is designed to stay on this device. You decide what to keep, export, or protect.

path.title: One thought at a time.
path.body: You don't need to solve everything at once. FreeCBT gives one thought room to change.

invitation.title: Want to try it first?
invitation.body: You can walk through one guided example, or jump straight to your own thought. Either way takes about the same time.
invitation.guided_body: See exactly how FreeCBT works with a made-up situation, one step at a time. Nothing personal to share yet.
invitation.quick_body: Skip the walkthrough and write your own first thought right now.

composer.title: What's on your mind right now?
composer.body: There's no right way to begin. A sentence, a phrase, or a question is enough.
composer.hint_ready: Your draft is ready to continue.

reminders.header: Before you finish, we can send you reminders if you'd like.
reminders.disabled: You can control reminders in the settings screen.

guided.begin_body: You will practice the same four-part record FreeCBT uses to slow down an upsetting thought.
guided.situation_title: Start with a moment, not a diagnosis.
guided.situation_body: Pick a made-up situation so you can learn the flow before sharing anything of your own.
guided.thought_body: The situation is one thing. The automatic thought is the conclusion that arrived with it.
guided.thought_revealed_hint: We're going to look at this thought closely — not treat it as a settled fact.
guided.pattern_body: These are thinking patterns, not labels about you. More than one can apply.
guided.evidence_title: Separate what happened from what it means.
guided.alternative_title: Make room for a fuller thought.
guided.alternative_body: It doesn't need to sound cheerful — it needs to feel more complete and believable.
guided.complete_title: You just made a thought record.
guided.complete_body: Next time you can start with your own moment — same four steps.
guided.your_turn_body: Start with the first step whenever you're ready — the rest can wait.
guided.your_turn_hint: This stays on your device. No account, no cloud.

home_handoff.title_empty: Your journal is ready when you are.
home_handoff.body_with_thought: Your first thought is now part of your journal. The rest can unfold at your pace.
home_handoff.body_empty: You can add your first thought any time — there's no deadline and no streak to keep.
home_handoff.journal_card_empty: No thought recorded yet — you can start one any time from here.
